record.bible_text: A prayer<WH08605> of Habakkuk<WH02265> the prophet<WH05030> upon Shigionoth<WH07692>. <RF>upon...: or, according to variable songs, or, tunes, called in Hebrew, Shigionoth<Rf>

O LORD<WH03068>, I have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> thy speech<WH08088>, <FI>and<Fi> was afraid<WH03372><WTH8804>: O LORD<WH03068>, revive<WH02421><WTH8761> thy work<WH06467> in the midst<WH07130> of the years<WH08141>, in the midst<WH07130> of the years<WH08141> make known<WH03045><WTH8686>; in wrath<WH07267> remember<WH02142><WTH8799> mercy<WH07355><WTH8763>. <RF>speech: Heb. report, or, hearing<Rf> <RF>revive: or, preserve alive<Rf><CM>

God<WH0433> came<WH0935><WTH8799> from Teman<WH08487>, and the Holy One<WH06918> from mount<WH02022> Paran<WH06290>. Selah<WH05542>. His glory<WH01935> covered<WH03680><WTH8765> the heavens<WH08064>, and the earth<WH0776> was full<WH04390><WTH8804> of his praise<WH08416>. <RF>Teman: or, the south<Rf>

And <FI>his<Fi> brightness<WH05051> was as the light<WH0216>; he had horns<WH07161> <FI>coming<Fi> out of his hand<WH03027>: and there <FI>was<Fi> the hiding<WH02253> of his power<WH05797>. <RF>horns...: or, bright beams out of his side<Rf>
Before<WH06440> him went<WH03212><WTH8799> the pestilence<WH01698>, and burning coals<WH07565> went forth<WH03318><WTH8799> at his feet<WH07272>. <RF>coals: or, diseases<Rf>

He stood<WH05975><WTH8804>, and measured<WH04128><WTH8787> the earth<WH0776>: he beheld<WH07200><WTH8804>, and drove asunder<WH05425><WTH8686> the nations<WH01471>; and the everlasting<WH05703> mountains<WH02042> were scattered<WH06327><WTH8691>, the perpetual<WH05769> hills<WH01389> did bow<WH07817><WTH8804>: his ways<WH01979> <FI>are<Fi> everlasting<WH05769>.

I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> the tents<WH0168> of Cushan<WH03572> in affliction<WH0205>: <FI>and<Fi> the curtains<WH03407> of the land<WH0776> of Midian<WH04080> did tremble<WH07264><WTH8799>. <RF>Cushan: or, Ethiopia<Rf> <RF>in...: or, under affliction, or, vanity<Rf>

Was the LORD<WH03068> displeased<WH02734><WTH8804> against the rivers<WH05104>? <FI>was<Fi> thine anger<WH0639> against the rivers<WH05104>? <FI>was<Fi> thy wrath<WH05678> against the sea<WH03220>, that thou didst ride<WH07392><WTH8799> upon thine horses<WH05483> <FI>and<Fi> thy chariots<WH04818> of salvation<WH03444>? <RF>of...: or, were salvation?<Rf>

Thy bow<WH07198> was made quite<WH06181> naked<WH05783><WTH8735>, <FI>according<Fi> to the oaths<WH07621> of the tribes<WH04294>, <FI>even thy<Fi> word<WH0562>. Selah<WH05542>. Thou didst cleave<WH01234><WTH8762> the earth<WH0776> with rivers<WH05104>. <RF>earth...: or, rivers of the earth<Rf>

The mountains<WH02022> saw<WH07200><WTH8804> thee, <FI>and<Fi> they trembled<WH02342><WTH8799>: the overflowing<WH02230> of the water<WH04325> passed by<WH05674><WTH8804>: the deep<WH08415> uttered<WH05414><WTH8804> his voice<WH06963>, <FI>and<Fi> lifted up<WH05375><WTH8804> his hands<WH03027> on high<WH07315>.

The sun<WH08121> <FI>and<Fi> moon<WH03394> stood still<WH05975><WTH8804> in their habitation<WH02073>: at the light<WH0216> of thine arrows<WH02671> they went<WH01980><WTH8762>, <FI>and<Fi> at the shining<WH05051> of thy glittering<WH01300> spear<WH02595>. <RF>at the light...: or, thine arrows walked in the light<Rf>
Thou didst march through<WH06805><WTH8799> the land<WH0776> in indignation<WH02195>, thou didst thresh<WH01758><WTH8799> the heathen<WH01471> in anger<WH0639>.

Thou wentest forth<WH03318><WTH8804> for the salvation<WH03468> of thy people<WH05971>, <FI>even<Fi> for salvation<WH03468> with thine anointed<WH04899>; thou woundedst<WH04272><WTH8804> the head<WH07218> out of the house<WH01004> of the wicked<WH07563>, by discovering<WH06168><WTH8763> the foundation<WH03247> unto the neck<WH06677>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>by...: Heb. making naked<Rf>

Thou didst strike through<WH05344><WTH8804> with his staves<WH04294> the head<WH07218> of his villages<WH06518>: they came out as a whirlwind<WH05590><WTH8799> to scatter<WH06327><WTH8687> me: their rejoicing<WH05951> <FI>was<Fi> as to devour<WH0398><WTH8800> the poor<WH06041> secretly<WH04565>. <RF>came...: Heb. were tempestuous<Rf>
Thou didst walk<WH01869><WTH8804> through the sea<WH03220> with thine horses<WH05483>, <FI>through<Fi> the heap<WH02563> of great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>. <RF>heap: or, mud<Rf><CM>

When I heard<WH08085><WTH8804>, my belly<WH0990> trembled<WH07264><WTH8799>; my lips<WH08193> quivered<WH06750><WTH8804> at the voice<WH06963>: rottenness<WH07538> entered<WH0935><WTH8799> into my bones<WH06106>, and I trembled<WH07264><WTH8799> in myself, that I might rest<WH05117><WTH8799> in the day<WH03117> of trouble<WH06869>: when he cometh up<WH05927><WTH8800> unto the people<WH05971>, he will invade them with his troops<WH01464><WTH8799>. <RF>invade...: or, cut them in pieces<Rf>

Although the fig tree<WH08384> shall not blossom<WH06524><WTH8799>, neither <FI>shall<Fi> fruit<WH02981> <FI>be<Fi> in the vines<WH01612>; the labour<WH04639> of the olive<WH02132> shall fail<WH03584><WTH8765>, and the fields<WH07709> shall yield<WH06213><WTH8804> no meat<WH0400>; the flock<WH06629> shall be cut off<WH01504><WTH8804> from the fold<WH04356>, and <FI>there shall be<Fi> no herd<WH01241> in the stalls<WH07517>: <RF>fail: Heb. lie<Rf>
Yet I will rejoice<WH05937><WTH8799> in the LORD<WH03068>, I will joy<WH01523><WTH8799> in the God<WH0430> of my salvation<WH03468>.

The LORD<WH03069> God<WH0136> <FI>is<Fi> my strength<WH02428>, and he will make<WH07760><WTH8799> my feet<WH07272> like hinds<WH0355>' <FI>feet<Fi> , and he will make me to walk<WH01869><WTH8686> upon mine high places<WH01116>. To the chief singer<WH05329><WTH8764> on my stringed instruments<WH05058>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>stringed...: Heb. Neginoth<Rf><CM>
